paragraph: Eliminate manual errors and wasted time. Scheduling Wizard delivers optimized on-call rosters as simple Excel files for easy upload to whatever platform you already use.

cta.title: Stop Building On Call Schedules by Hand
cta.description: Join 30+ departments across 20+ hospitals and practices who already trust Scheduling Wizard with their on call scheduling. Finished schedules in your format, with redrafts through the year included.

faq.answer: On call scheduling software automates the creation and distribution of on-call shifts for medical residents and fellows. Traditional tools are self-service platforms that programs operate themselves, while Scheduling Wizard takes a different approach as a fully managed service, programs submit their rules and receive finished, ACGME-compliant on call schedules delivered as Excel files, with no software for the team to learn or operate.
faq.question: What is on call scheduling software for residency programs?

faq.answer: For a residency or fellowship we apply the duty hour rules while the call schedule is built rather than reviewing it afterward: the 80-hour weekly limit, minimum rest between shifts, the 24-hour maximum shift, and the specialty-specific Program Requirements. We work from the requirements your program tells us apply, and we redraft when something needs to change. A group or practice outside GME has no ACGME requirement, so we build to their own rules instead.
faq.question: How do you handle ACGME duty hours in a call schedule?

faq.answer: Most on call scheduling software requires your team to learn and operate the platform, manually input rules, and troubleshoot compliance issues. Scheduling Wizard is a managed service; your program submits rules and receives finished schedules. There is no software to learn and no annual retraining when chief residents rotate. Your finished schedules are delivered as Excel files ready to upload to publishing platform.
faq.question: How is Scheduling Wizard different from self-service on call scheduling software?

faq.answer: Yes. Many Scheduling Wizard clients continue using the platform they already have for day-to-day schedule access. Scheduling Wizard handles the schedule creation and optimization, delivering the finished on call schedule as an Excel file that you upload directly into your existing viewing platform. The two tools serve different functions and are designed to complement each other.
faq.question: Can Scheduling Wizard work alongside your existing platform?

faq.answer: Call, weekend, and holiday burden is distributed algorithmically across all residents so that each person carries an equitable share. Our team factors in individual rules such as vacation requests, conference dates, and moonlighting restrictions, then balances the remaining call load mathematically. This eliminates the manual auditing and fairness disputes that are common with spreadsheet-based or self-service scheduling approaches.
faq.question: How does Scheduling Wizard handle fairness in on call schedule distribution?

faq.answer: Scheduling Wizard delivers Block and Rotation schedules, Call schedules, Clinic schedules, and Attending schedules. All schedule types are optimized simultaneously so that a change in one does not create conflicts in another. Finished schedules are delivered as Excel spreadsheets that programs can upload to their existing tools for day-to-day access.
faq.question: What types of schedules does Scheduling Wizard deliver for residency programs?

items.title: Fair On Call Schedule Generation
items.description: Builds on call schedules that spread the call burden equitably across everyone on it, respecting rest rules, post-call recovery and individual requests, all in a single pass.
